policy.reason: Do not invent per-chapter triangle or texture-memory ceilings before measured target-device baselines exist.
policy.source_audit_role: Report source triangle equivalents, source bytes, texture dimensions and structural defects on every production-asset batch.

provisional_review_thresholds.note: Review threshold only; Unreal import compression/mips and actual residency decide runtime cost.

promotion_rule: Hard per-chapter limits may be enabled only after a reproducible target-device capture records scene identity, commit SHA, FPS/frame time and memory evidence.

rules: Decorative repeated detail should use HISM when it does not need independent gameplay state.
V10 detail clusters are non-colliding and shadow-disabled by default.
Cull distances are explicit per cluster.
Target-device measurements may reduce instance counts/cull ranges without changing story topology.
Ephemeral micro-event motion uses bounded event counts.
Glow accents are shadowless and should be disabled before story-critical lighting under performance pressure.
No ambient motion actor owns quest/save state.
Source BMP byte size is not equivalent to runtime VRAM residency. Imported Unreal texture resolution, pixel format/compression, mip chain, streaming and residency determine runtime texture cost.
The current 24 production BMP sources total about 0.53 MiB, so the claim that this source set will by itself fill a 2 GB VRAM target is not supported by current repository evidence.

BMP remains a weak choice for future masked foliage or other assets that need reliable alpha authoring. Use an alpha-capable source format such as PNG/TGA for those assets when the art actually requires alpha.
Do not batch-convert existing textures without also updating the production importer, path references, material bindings, validators and import regression proof.
Follow Source 11: profile representative scenes before setting hard texture/VRAM budgets.
texture_source_format_review.migration_trigger: Introduce PNG/TGA selectively when alpha/high-fidelity authored textures arrive; add importer support first, then migrate in a dedicated asset-pipeline change.

rules: Current direct LoadObject calls are synchronous loads and are a real chapter-transition hitch risk as production assets grow.
Do not replace every call mechanically with TSoftObjectPtr and assume memory is solved.
Build bounded chapter/region asset banks using soft paths/references plus FStreamableManager or AssetManager async preload where justified.
Prefetch before narrative seams or under authored masked transitions; keep strong references while assets are actively needed.
Release streamable handles/region ownership after safe chapter unload and let Unreal GC/streaming reclaim eligible resources.
Measure transition hitch, streaming pool and resident memory before and after migration.
LivingWorldDirector currently spawns/culls/destroys ambient baseline actors and ephemeral event actors, so spawn/GC churn is a legitimate profile target.
Do not impose an arbitrary fixed pool of 15 actors: current designed baseline alone reaches 18 in P1C01 before bounded micro-events.
If profiling shows spawn/Destroy/GC hitch, pool only ambient archetypes/ephemeral actors first; named persistent NPCs retain stable identity/state ownership.
A pooled inactive actor must disable tick, collision, perception/interaction and rendering before reuse; reset routine/appearance/event state explicitly.
Pooling reduces allocation/GC churn but does not make retained meshes/textures free in RAM/VRAM.
ambient_actor_pooling_review.trigger: Implement only after target-device or representative trace shows material spawn/GC cost.

rules: When final PBR texture sets introduce separate AO/roughness/metallic maps, define one project-wide packed-mask convention (for example ORM) with sRGB disabled.
Channel packing may reduce texture count/sampler pressure and can reduce memory, but the exact saving is compression/format dependent and must not be claimed as a universal 66 percent.
Current repository does not contain separate AO/roughness/metallic source texture sets that justify a bulk packing pass today.
Alpha foliage still needs an alpha-capable source/import path independently of packed-mask policy.
